integrity: The infinite statement is supported by a direct proof. Exhaustive computation through order 10 is a finite stress test and is not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific limitations: The exact formula is proved for connected complete multipartite graphs. The literature comparison is limited by indexing and partial access to older sources; the closest complete-bipartite upper theorem was inspected in full text, while some older complete-multipartite minimum-parameter sources were available only through abstracts or later restatements.
title: Upper signed domination of complete multipartite graphs
